# Bundled calculator dependencies

These are the libraries resolved by the original calculator's CDN URLs on 2026-10-14. They are shared by the modern and preserved calculators. No package installation or external request is required to run either page. Do not upgrade the statistics library without rerunning the parity and independent reference tests.

| File | Version | Original source | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jstat.min.js` | jStat 1.9.6 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jstat@latest/dist/jstat.min.js | `e478a6ab6324e735d927529b5e97506df97dd3a4ced8c744c8e00b90da95dcc0` |
| `plotly.min.js` | Plotly.js 1.58.5 | https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-latest.min.js | `60f2b60a8b0e6f1212061db4cf56e1e45660d8cd5f77aabee2679c7d0701f57b` |
| `w3.css` | W3.CSS 4.15 | https://www.w3schools.com/w3css/4/w3.css | `4a7611bc677873a0f87fe21727bc3a2a43f57a5ded3b10ce33a0f371a2e6030f` |

The jStat and Plotly MIT licenses are included alongside their files. W3.CSS is used only by the original calculator; its author notice is preserved. See https://www.w3schools.com/w3css/ for its usage terms. The modern page uses the repository's own CSS and system fonts.
